skill.name: nature-citation
skill.description: Find Nature, Science, Cell, and related journal citations for manuscript claims. The skill segments text, searches bibliographic metadata, filters scope, and exports reference-manager files.
skill.summary: Find scoped Nature/CNS citation candidates and export them for reference managers.
skill.author: Yuan1z skill, refactored into static/dynamic layers

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code spans, CSS, citation keys, Unicode matching, or RDF namespace examples. Confirmed risks are limited to expected outbound Crossref requests, predictable temporary output paths, and one generated HTML innerHTML insertion that can expose users to metadata-based XSS.

remediation.issue: Generated citation browser inserts external metadata with innerHTML.
remediation.suggestion: Build selected-reference rows with textContent or escaped DOM nodes instead of innerHTML for title, journal, and year fields.

remediation.issue: Manuscript-derived queries are sent to Crossref during live searches.
remediation.suggestion: Show a clear consent notice before network searches and document an offline DOI-only workflow for confidential manuscripts.

remediation.issue: Examples write outputs to a predictable /tmp/nature-citation path.
remediation.suggestion: Use a private per-run output directory with restrictive permissions, or default to a project-local path chosen by the user.

content.value_statement: Researchers need defensible citations that match each manuscript claim and journal scope. This skill segments text, searches Nature/CNS-family metadata, and exports reference-manager files.
actual_capabilities: Splits manuscript text into claim-level segments with stable IDs.
Searches Crossref for candidate journal articles within Nature/CNS scope.
Filters candidates by journal family, flagship scope, and publication year.
Exports ENW, RIS, and Zotero RDF reference files.
Generates optional HTML, TSV, JSON, and Markdown review artifacts.
Supports Chinese prompts while using English scientific search terms.
limitations: Candidate support remains metadata-only until abstracts or full text are checked.
Live search requires internet access and sends query text to Crossref.
Coverage is restricted to configured journal families unless the user broadens scope.
The tool does not replace expert literature review or clinical guidance.

use_cases.title: Add Citations to a Manuscript Section
use_cases.description: Map each citable sentence to scoped candidate papers and export selected references.

use_cases.title: Prepare Reference Manager Imports
use_cases.description: Create ENW, RIS, or Zotero RDF files from verified candidate records.

use_cases.title: Screen Claims Against CNS Scope
use_cases.description: Check whether claims have support within Nature, Science, Cell, or sister journals.

prompt_templates.title: Find Basic Citation Candidates
prompt_templates.prompt: Find Nature/CNS citation candidates for this paragraph and export an ENW file: [paste text].

prompt_templates.title: Limit Scope and Years
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Nature Portfolio journals only, from 2018 to 2026. Segment this text and return candidate citations: [paste text].

prompt_templates.title: Create a Review Browser
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate the HTML review browser and RIS export for these claims. Let me filter by year and choose references: [paste claims].

prompt_templates.title: Process a Long Manuscript
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with batching and audit notes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Batch this long manuscript by section, keep a segment-reference map, flag weak support, and export Zotero RDF: [paste text].

output_examples.input: A paragraph about immune evasion in pancreatic cancer needing CNS citations.
output_examples.output: The skill returns segment IDs, candidate papers, support grades, insertion suggestions, and one ENW reference file.

output_examples.input: A Chinese request for Nature-series citations with manual download choices.
output_examples.output: The skill provides Chinese review notes, an HTML browser, year filters, and downloadable ENW, RIS, or Zotero RDF records.

output_examples.input: A DOI list already approved by the author.
output_examples.output: The skill screens metadata, avoids invented fields, and exports a clean reference-manager file.

best_practices: State journal scope and year limits before searching.
Check abstracts or publisher pages before treating candidates as support.
Use the HTML review browser for long or ambiguous manuscripts.
anti_patterns: Do not cite metadata-only candidates as confirmed support.
Do not broaden beyond Nature/CNS scope without user approval.
Do not send confidential manuscript text to live search without consent.

faq.question: Does this skill verify that a paper supports my exact claim?
faq.answer: It provides conservative support notes, but users must check abstracts or full text before final citation use.

faq.question: Which reference formats are supported?
faq.answer: The script can export ENW, RIS, and Zotero RDF files.

faq.question: Can it handle Chinese requests?
faq.answer: Yes. It can accept Chinese prompts and return Chinese notes while searching with English scientific terms.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: Live candidate search uses Crossref, so internet access is required unless you provide known DOI records.

faq.question: Can I restrict results to flagship journals only?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow supports a flagship scope for Nature, Science, and Cell only.

faq.question: Is it safe for unpublished manuscripts?
faq.answer: Use caution. Live searches send query text externally, so confidential material should use DOI-only or redacted workflows.
